name: software.altweb/altweb-context
title: ALTWEB Context Loader
description: Loads signed ALTWEB context capsules — refuses unsigned, tampered, or untrusted by default.

environmentVariables.name: ALTWEB_TRUST_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Override the local trust file of allowed signer public keys (default: ~/.altweb/trusted-keys.json). A missing or empty trust file refuses every capsule.
